name: Rocket Car Parts
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Heh heh, with all the races they're running here, it's no surprise that a few mishaps happen along the way.  If you look around the Shimmering Flats then you'll see evidence of past crashes -- scraps of rocket car parts are littered everywhere!

And those parts are worth money to the gnomes and goblins.  They're always looking for more contraptions to slap onto their cars.

So go out and get me parts.  Bring me a heap and I'll pay you well.
narrative.objectives: Bring 30 Rocket Car Parts to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Whoa, look at all that! There's some good stuff in that heap of junk. I'm sure I can pawn it off for a hefty sum.

And... is that an ear I see squashed between those two sheets of metal?? Ouch! Heh, I sure wouldn't want to be that pilot!

Thanks, adventurer. Here's your pay. And here's some advice, free of charge...

If you look hard enough, you can always find profit in someone else's tragedy.
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, have you been out into the Flats? Did you bring back that load of parts I wanted?
